# Evalue Calculations 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df_or <- read_csv("all_imputed_table_results.csv")

# add e-value columns based on calculation for when Odds Ratios > 0.15
df_evalue <- df_or %>% dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(rr = sqrt(or),
  evalue = ifelse(rr>1, rr + sqrt(rr*(rr-1)), 1/rr + sqrt(1/rr*(1/rr-1))),
                           evalue_ll = ll + sqrt(ll*(ll-1)),
                           evalue_ul = 1/ul + sqrt(1/ul + sqrt(1/ul*(1/ul -1)))
)
```
